newsitem.title: USA: Kensey Nash updates Angio-Seal status.
newsitem.headline: Kensey Nash updates Angio-Seal status.

text.p: Kensey Nash Corp said Tuesday that American Home Products Corp's Quinton Instrument Co unit has submitted data to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) on Angio-Seal, documenting the corrective actions made to its manufacturing process since the voluntary product recall was on January 27.
Quinston is Kensey Nash's corporate partner and manufacturer of Kensey Nash's Angio-Seal device for the U.S. market.
Joseph Kaufmann, president and chief executive, gave the update at the Bear Stearns Emerging Medical Technology Conference in New York.
The FDA is reviewing the submission and has not given a firm commitment on when it will respond.
